address: 5240 Annunciation St., New Orleans, LA, 70115, USA
bio: There are some places that have earned cult status for their offerings, and Domilise's Po-Boy & Bar, opened since 1918, is one of them. Here in their humble sandwich shop on a corner of Uptown, they serve a small menu of sandwiches. They're not just any sandwiches, of course. These are po'boys, and they're legendary. Walk in, chat with the friendly staff and place your order for a shrimp po'boy—it's what everyone else is here for too. Battered, fried shrimp bathed in a hot sauce are tucked inside Leidenheimer bread with shredded lettuce, mayo and a pickle. You'll be back for another soon enough. - Friendly order at the counter, take a seat and they’ll call your name to come pick up at the kitchen.- PLEASE FEATURE- Shrimp Po'boy -...
